policy: References informed shell proportions (whorl count, spire angle, length to width ratio, sculpture layout, aperture and canal form), soft-part layout and colour placement only. No pixels were sampled, traced, copied or redistributed. Seller imagery was not used as a texture or tracing source. The trade name 'cerith snail' covers several Cerithium species, so the asset is labelled at genus level.

referenceGradeRationale: Shell proportions (whorl count, spire angle, length to width ratio, cord layout, aperture and canal form) are calibrated from published genus and species descriptions and openly licensed apertural shell photographs. Soft-part proportions (foot, snout, tentacle length, siphon) are inferred from general cerithiid anatomy because calibrated live side, top and front photographs are not openly available; taxonomy is genus level because the trade name spans several Cerithium species.
